name: podBaseUrl
label: Pod Base URL
help: The base URL of your ConnectSecure pod, e.g. `https://pod401.myconnectsecure.com`. Do **not** include a trailing slash or path — the plugin appends those automatically.

name: tenantName
label: Tenant Name
help: Your ConnectSecure tenant name, exactly as configured on your account. Used together with your Client ID to authenticate.

name: clientId
label: Client ID
help: The API client ID issued by ConnectSecure. Contact your ConnectSecure account administrator or ConnectSecure support if you don't have API access enabled yet.

name: clientSecret
label: Client Secret
help: The API client secret issued by ConnectSecure, paired with the Client ID above.

name: userId
label: API User ID
help: The `user_id` returned by ConnectSecure's `/w/authorize` endpoint for your API credentials. This is a stable value tied to your Client ID/Secret, so you only need to capture it once — see the plugin's documentation for a copy-paste command to retrieve it.
